name: quality
description: Runs the quality rules on the silver tables; returns whether publishing is allowed and the failing rules.

only.description: Run only these rules (all if empty)

returns: run_id, checked, failed, warned, publish_allowed, problems (check, table, status, observed, expected, owner)
permissions: Reads silver; writes only to quality.check_results and quality.quarantine. Cannot change the rules file.
